notes: Machine-readable provenance for the Codex request-body fixture corpus. tests/unit/test_codex_body_fixtures.py is the gate; README.md renders the same facts for humans and is pinned against this file. The marker never lives inside a body: an extra top-level key would change the recorded shape. A captured body is REBUILT from a structural allowlist rather than scrubbed, so it carries the shape of the real request (keys, discriminators, tool declaration field sets, item ids, call/output pairing) and none of its prose: every free-text field holds a synthetic placeholder derived from its own JSON path. The recorded shape is asserted to be unchanged by that rebuild.

captured_gpt55_standard_http.json.notes: Real Codex 0.154.0 standard body. Every input item carries a source-minted prefixed id, the tool_search declaration carries an execution field and web_search carries external_web_access/search_content_types -- the shape facts the traffic-parity work needs recorded. The prose of this body is synthetic; the shape is the real one.

captured_gpt56sol_lite_http.json.notes: Real Codex 0.154.0 Responses-Lite body. It carries no instructions key at all, so it must be validated through normalize_responses_request_payload with openai_compat from _has_openai_responses_shape; bare ResponsesRequest.model_validate fails with 'instructions Field required'. Its additional_tools bundle declares the functions and collaboration namespaces (no web, no image_gen in this lane) and four developer prefix messages. The prose of this body is synthetic; the namespace/tool structure is the real one.

gpt55_standard_first_turn.json.notes: Hand-written pre-strip fixture: it keeps client_metadata and stream_options on purpose, because its job is to feed strip_source_telemetry. Shape-illustrative, not byte-faithful -- compare the README divergence table against the captured pair before citing it as ground truth. Its identifiers are placeholders, so the privacy gate only exempts the bare telemetry key names.

gpt56_lite_bundle.json.notes: Hand-written pre-strip Responses-Lite fixture. Its reasoning.context is the one shape fact the synthetic pair gets right against a real capture; its namespaces, developer prefix and empty instructions do not match Codex 0.154.0.
